authorization.question: Can the accepted Supertonic route run all neural components on QNN, and does precompiled EPContext loading reduce cold setup versus source-ONNX QNN compilation?
authorization.phone: Standing authorization after sound host/context smoke, subject to the shared phone lock and exact device/safety checks.

graphs.matching_rule: The source-compilation and context-reload arms must use the same effective graphs, provider configuration, input, runner and device. A documented context-generation derivative is allowed only if both arms remain matched to it.

context.reload: external descriptor plus binary; source ONNX unavailable

matched_arms.source: Fresh process creates all four sessions from source ONNX; compilation is inside measured setup.
matched_arms.context: Fresh process creates all four sessions from external EPContext descriptors/binaries generated offline; source ONNX is unavailable.
matched_arms.setup_boundary: Process start and per-session construction are both recorded; ready means all four sessions are constructed and the runner can begin generation.

minimum_measurements.rtf: generation seconds divided by actual emitted audio seconds

claim_critical_safeguards: ORT CPU fallback disabled for all QNN neural sessions
context reload proven with source ONNX unavailable
at least three fresh-process cold setup runs per arm
scoped phone lock, transport, identity, staging and cleanup safety

current_checkpoint.result: All four graphs generated external contexts and independently reloaded in source-absent host containers with QNN-only ORT node events.
current_checkpoint.timing_exclusion: All current host timing/resource observations overlapped experiment 0017 and are excluded from startup/performance claims.
current_checkpoint.pause: No QNN session/compiler or phone work until Pi/Jens explicitly clears the serialized experiment-0017 host run.
